premises.text: Enterprise knowledge is siloed in email/IM/conversations so people repeat work and cannot find who knows what
premises.evidence_span: all the knowledge was siloed. It was siloed in emails, IMs, conversations. There was no good knowledge base

premises.text: Quora-like Q&A melded with wiki flexibility creates an organically growing searchable enterprise knowledge base
premises.evidence_span: take the power of a Q&A site, meld it with the flexibility of wikis to create a really organically growing, really easily searchable knowledge base for the enterprise

premises.text: Corporate-email verified signup into question-organized content with voting, anonymity, and powerful search
premises.evidence_span: someone at a company signs up for Opsy using their corporate email address, which we then verify

premises.text: Email/listserv integration: ask/answer by email and extract questions into the searchable index
premises.evidence_span: we allow people to ask questions directly by email, answer them directly by replying to an email

premises.text: Intelligent email routing of questions to suitable answerers inside the company
premises.evidence_span: intelligently route questions directly via email to people that we think are the most suitable candidates

value.text: Help people at companies share knowledge—first place to turn for answers
value.evidence_span: help people at companies share knowledge

causal_links.evidence_span: not being able to know what other people already knew
easily searchable knowledge base for the enterprise
people and companies live in their Outlook email boxes

notes: Wiki/voting/anonymous/search features folded as cascade of one Q&A knowledge-base mechanism (§4.1.7). Eng/sales/CS/law use cases are applications of same platform—not separate premises. Seed investors and waitlist excluded as credentials/traction (§4.2). Email routing kept as separately claimed WIP module. Anti-template: problem, core product, email integrations separately revisable.
